articles.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
articles.snippet: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

articles.title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether
articles.snippet: The Bitmine chairman said he expects younger investors to drive demand for digital assets as his ether treasury company inches closer to owning 5% of the total supply.

articles.title: Tokenized catastrophe bonds target the disaster-insurance gap
articles.snippet: A planned Bermuda issuance would put legal ownership onchain and seek capital for disaster risks that remain costly to insure.

articles.title: Standard Chartered offers RLUSD custody in Dubai and plans LMAX collateral link
articles.snippet: Ripple previously gave LMAX $150 million in financing to integrate RLUSD into its institutional infrastructure.

articles.title: Ledger claims CryptoBilis cases are limited as up to $93 million is traced, $10 million frozen
articles.snippet: Ledger said every confirmed case involves devices sold by the Southeast Asian reseller, but critics say the hardware-wallet maker must answer for an authorized sales channel.
